title: Livestock Treatment Checklist
subtitle: Livestock Treatment: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Livestock Treatment Checklist covers animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition. The livestock care record owner records Livestock Treatment criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Livestock Treatment Checklist keeps Livestock Treatment exceptions visible until the livestock care record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Livestock Treatment Checklist at pen, pasture, barn, treatment area, and product storage location. Document animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition identity before Livestock Treatment begins. Compare animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition findings with stated Livestock Treatment criteria; route unresolved Livestock Treatment issues to veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer. For Livestock Treatment Checklist, confirm requirements for Livestock Treatment. Ask veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer to review Livestock Treatment conditions beyond the livestock care record owner's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Livestock Treatment, identify responsible parties, pen, pasture, barn, treatment area, and product storage location, and the linked animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition source.

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Livestock Treatment facts for animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Livestock Treatment finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Livestock Care Record Owner records reviewer disposition.

blocks.guidance: Pause Livestock Treatment when animal identity, treatment authority, dose, adverse response, withdrawal, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Livestock Treatment proof and route unresolved animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition scope to livestock care record owner.
